result.title: Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models
result.summary: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HWM 框架，把世界模型主干 latent 表示到学到的相空间（广义坐标与动量）中，用耗散哈密顿动力学递推未来状态并经可学习逆接口映回原 latent，配合多步转移监督，在多个具身世界模型上验证长时程预测稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化 latent 状态演化＋多步转移监督」是可核查的方法线索：或可迁移到 LVR 的 latent 推理状态更新与轨迹监督，缓解递归滚动中的表示漂移，但其与语言侧推理状态是否同构仍需人工判断。
